info.name: Profile API
Exports the result of a profile query in a formatted file for download

params.name: query
params.description: See https://www.npmjs.com/package/mongo-querystring for export query syntax.

items.docs: For format=csv, due to the flat file format, only primitive types will be exported. Non-primitive type will be exported with "--INVALID-TYPE--" as the data. Nested data should be referred to explicitly: "address.line1"

params.description: Retrieves the device details associated with the profile, such as browsers and mobile devices

params.description: Includes details of the App Messaging sessions that the profile has

params.description: Limits the fields returned by the query to one or more specific field names

params.name: $includeDeleted
params.description: Includes deleted profiles in the result

params.name: $includeSystem
params.description: Includes system profiles in the result

params.name: $limit
params.description: Limits the number of results returned

params.description: Returns the schema of a sample of profiles

params.description: Starts results at a specific record index
